title: Regulatory Signal Workbench and Prioritization Advisor for Security/Compliance Requests
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem statement: Enterprise customers submit a broad set of non-bug security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO attestations, HIPAA scoping, GDPR/DPA questions, vendor questionnaires). Right now triage is manual, inconsistent, and opaque to customers and Sales/Customer Success. We need a structured, repeatable way to score incoming signals and recommend an action lane (self-serve, evidence helper, Legal/Security review, Sales escalation) plus a human-in-the-loop advisory mode for borderline cases.

Goals:
- Create a visible "Signal Workbench" in the Console for PM/Support/Sales/Legal to triage incoming asks.
- Implement a reproducible prioritization advisor that scores requests across risk, contractual exposure, implementation effort, and customer tier.
- Surface recommended next steps and required evidence templates to reduce back-and-forth by >= 40% for standard questionnaires.
- Provide SLAs and routing rules (High-risk triage <= 2 business days).

Scope (in):
- Intake schema for security/compliance asks submitted via Support form and Sales intake.
- Scoring engine prototype with tunable weights for signals: regulatory type, data residency, customer tier, contract language, timeline.
- Console workbench UI mockups and a minimal API for automation.
- Evidence template mapping for common questionnaires (SIG, vendor security questionnaire, basic DPA checklist).

Out of scope (for this ticket):
- Full legal automation or auto-signed contractual exceptions.
- Deep integration with external vendors (third-party attestations) — future phase.

Success metrics:
- Reduction in average cycle time for standard questionnaire answers from intake to delivery by 40% for pilot customers.
- >80% accuracy of advisor lane recommendation on pilot set (legal reviewed).
- Decrease in manual handoffs per ask by 30% in pilot.

Trade-offs and decisions to make:
- Heuristic vs ML scoring: start with deterministic weighted scorer so Legal can reason about decisions, enable ML ranking in later cycles.
- Surface minimal data in Console to avoid leaking sensitive customer context; record full evidence only in secure drive links behind access controls.
- Prioritize UX clarity for CS teams over building a fully generalized ontology in first iteration.
acceptance_criteria: Intake schema defined and implemented for support+sales channels with sample payloads
Scoring engine prototype returns stable lane recommendation for a curated set of 50 historical asks
Console workbench mockups reviewed and approved by Design and Legal
Evidence templates for top 5 questionnaire types published in Drive and linked from Console
Routing rules implemented for 'High' risk to auto-alert Legal and set triage SLA to 2 business days
Audit log entries for every triage decision stored and queryable via Console
tasks: Product: finalize prioritization signals and weight table
Design: produce 3 workbench mock variants and a compact evidence panel
Backend: implement intake schema and scoring service endpoint
Console: add workbench route and a results panel for recommended lane + evidence links
Legal: review scoring table and approve initial criteria for 'High' and 'Medium' risk
Support/CS: identify 5 pilot customers and prepare pilot runbook
SRE/Security: define audit log retention and access controls for stored evidence links
Docs: draft internal playbook and customer-facing guidance for the new intake flow
